title: A natural number is at most its square

steps.text: If $n = 0$, both sides equal $0$ — there is nothing to prove.

Otherwise $n \ge 1$; multiplying both sides by $n \ge 0$ gives $n \cdot n \ge n$,
that is, $n^2 \ge n$.
